@tanwarsh can you `import triton` on your system? And how did you install Python/PyTorch? Mind sharing the output of `pip list`?

Can't repro this using latest nightly:
```
https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu124/torch-2.6.0.dev20241216%2Bcu124-cp313-cp313-linux_x86_64.whl
https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu124/torchvision-0.22.0.dev20241216%2Bcu124-cp313-cp313-linux_x86_64.whl
```

This sounds like a user setup issue. Issues are for bugs and feature requests only, for questions consider asking on the forums https://discuss.pytorch.org/

Keeping this issue open though in case the PT2 team has comment on the triton side (feel free to close).
